headline: Check Local Access for the Binevenagh Plateau
reservation: Entry to the Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty is generally open access without a central permit system. Visitors should verify specific access for recreational activities like angling or gliding and check for seasonal road closures on high-altitude routes.

days.title: North Coast Vistas and Heritage

stops.name: Gortmore viewpoint
stops.detail: Observe panoramic views extending to Inishowen and the Scottish islands of Islay and Jura. Look for distant landmarks including the Mussenden Temple and Martello Tower along the coast.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for local transit; conditions vary on steep plateau roads.
days.note: Pace your visit to allow for walking or cycling along the cliff edges if weather permits.

intel.title: Road and Rail Links
intel.text: The area is accessible by road, rail, air, and sea, making it a popular destination. Specific parking capacities at the plateau viewpoints are not documented in official sources; verify local site signage.

intel.title: Variable Coastal Visibility
intel.text: Clear days are required to see the Scottish islands from the clifftop. Plan for rapid weather changes typical of the Northern Ireland coastline.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: Evidence does not confirm mobile signal strength on the Binevenagh plateau. Download offline maps for navigating the rural roads before departure.

intel.title: Rural Supply Gaps
intel.text: Fuel locations are not specified within the AONB boundaries. Refill in gateway towns like Limavady or Coleraine before ascending the mountain roads.

intel.title: Viewpoint Facilities
intel.text: Official evidence notes easy access by road to the Gortmore viewpoint. Specific parking fill times or bay counts are unavailable and should be verified on-site.

plan.arrival: Travelers typically arrive via Limavady or Coleraine, picking up supplies in these hubs before heading to the clifftop roads.
plan.vehicle: Suitable for standard cars; check rental agreements for restrictions on steep, narrow rural lanes.
plan.goldenHour: Gortmore viewpoint offers westward views ideal for sunset, though visibility is season-dependent.

sources.label: Causeway Coast and Glens Heritage Trust
